character.description: The same young adult woman anime protagonist throughout this theme's entire music video: smoke-silver hair cut in a precise asymmetrical bob, one pale-gold eye and one blue-grey eye, with a distinct recognizable face and consistent adult proportions. They are a chronometry engineer repairing fractured passages through time. Signature outfit: a midnight technician's coat with brass dial fasteners, fitted trousers, and reinforced boots. Unique personal keepsake or tool: a cracked pocket chronometer that glows when timelines overlap. Preserve the exact facial features, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, body proportions, outfit silhouette, and defining item in every scene.
consistency_rules: Keep this theme's named visual identity as one fixed protagonist across every scene.
Preserve the exact face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, age impression, and body proportions.
Maintain the signature costume, distinctive accessories, and defining personal item without random redesign.
Do not replace the lead or add another protagonist unless the lyrics explicitly require it.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in endless hall of doors, ring of floating clocks, giant hourglass; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with chrono blue, brass gold, violet mist, white light; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by slow dolly down an endless corridor, spiraling shot around floating clock gears, close-up of falling sand; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
